people.name: Canaan
people.line: Son of Ham; father of Sidon and Heth

people.name: Japheth
people.line: Son of Noah, ancestor of Indo-European peoples

people.name: Shem
people.line: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples

translations.web: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”
translations.bsb: May God expand the territory of Japheth; may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant.”
translations.kjv: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
translations.asv: God enlarge Japheth, And let him dwell in the tents of Shem; And let Canaan be his servant.
